Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard Sri Saurabh Pandey, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Saksham Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant-accused, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.283 of 2021,
under Sections 376, 313, 323 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, police station Chopan, District Sonbhadra with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

According to prosecution version, in the year 2014 when the prosecutrix was a student of class 10th,
one day applicant-accused has forcibly established physical relations with her but later on they have married each other in a temple and thereafter, they lived as husband and wife for seven years.

It was alleged that on 08.02.2021 the applicant-accused has turned the prosecutrix out from his home by Devi Prasad Gond vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93061213/
1 saying that he would marry with some other girl and that he has also got terminated her pregnancy.

sentences.text: It has
been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
As per version of prosecutrix herself, she has married with applicant-accused and they lived as husband and wife for seven years but during that period, no complaint was made.
Prosecutrix is a mature lady, aged about 24-25 years.
In her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she has reiterated that she has married with applicant-accused and that she still wants to live with applicant-accused.
Referring to the facts of the matter, it was submitted that no case is made out against applicant-accused.

Lastly, it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 04.04.2022 having no criminal history and that in case, the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that in the year 2014 applicant-accused has committed rape upon prosecutrix and at that time she was a minor girl.
It was also alleged that applicant-accused has got terminated her pregnancy and turned her out from his home.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant-accused Devi Prasad Gond involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5. The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant-accused in accordance with law.
